observation_summary: The MultiplePiePlot constructor fails to register the plot as a listener to the provided dataset, unlike the setDataset method which correctly performs this registration.
reasoning_summary: The bug report explicitly states that the dataset is not 'wired to a listener' when passed to the constructor, which is a communication/interface issue between the plot object and the dataset object. This is a classic case of an object failing to establish the necessary observer relationship via the expected interface/method call during initialization.
evidence_used: The bug report states: 'When dataset is passed into constructor for MultiplePiePlot, the dataset is not wired to a listener, as it would be if setDataset is called.'
The test case 'testConstructor' fails at 'assertTrue(dataset.hasListener(plot));', confirming the plot is not registered as a listener.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the failure occurs during object construction, the root cause is the failure to establish a communication link (listener registration) between two objects, which is better described as an Interface/O-O Message issue.

The listener pattern is a behavioral relationship, but the specific mechanism of the failure is the missing call to register the listener, which fits the Interface/O-O Messages definition of communication problems between objects.
